subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers be unconditionally denied `sessions.patch` access to legacy ownerless rows while non-plugin operators retain access?
rationale: These rows predate plugin ownership metadata, so denying all plugin-runtime access is an intentional persisted-state upgrade policy that source correctness alone cannot decide.

options.title: Fail Closed
options.body: Reject plugin-runtime patches to ownerless rows and document plus prove the non-plugin operator recovery path.

options.title: Migrate Legacy Rows
options.body: Add a doctor-owned migration if legacy plugin sessions must retain access through an attributable plugin owner.

recommendation.title: Fail Closed
recommendation.body: Reject plugin-runtime patches to ownerless rows and document plus prove the non-plugin operator recovery path.
